entry_points: VerifiedCapture.member / CapturedMemberHandle.read_bytes/read_text / CapturedJsonArtifact.value/audit / CapturedBindings.require (the handle API), and the _LIFECYCLE_VIEWS handle registry
scope.non_goal: durable or cross-process consume-once and reconstruction remain Packet 8; this packet proves in-process equality and fail-closed restart identity only. Signature forgery under the caller-known development _DEV_KEY is ADR-0126-deferred, not closed here.

identity_bindings.binding: Operational published-handle lookup selects only the authenticated publish-stream intern stream ID, never a descriptor-prefix scan. A shared retained identity helper validates exact signed receipt producer/root/node/output, stream-pin purpose/digest/session, and independent authenticated publish-sealed prepared producer/root/purpose/stream/session and original output path/manifest. Return retained six-field descriptor; compare mutable handle descriptor only after validating retained identity. Reload current receipt store only on operational paths; preserve v1 bytes and sole writer.

ConsumerCapturedPort is derived from the frozen source digest and exact original consumer node/input/purpose. The existing authenticated freeze intern must retain the original publication plus immutable frozen identity; validate those fields and source bytes before deriving a port. One handle poke or one intern-map write cannot move the port, including to another valid declared input in the same source document. Reuse the existing freeze intern owner and sweep every reader, including P4 preparation and captured_bindings.
capture/_prepare_legacy_capture requires port == derive_consumer_port(frozen), the frozen intern to match published, consumer run distinct from producer session run, and the producer session ended.
open_capture/captured_bindings/_consume_binding bind session, bound_session, stream_id, run_identity, and transition_nonce; a session from another run/process/purpose refuses.
open_capture re-checks member_manifest_sha256 and each member sha256/bytes against the sealed digests; a mutated or substituted member refuses.

start_producer_session/end_session carry the producer-session identity that capture_port/session_stream depend on (consumer run distinct from producer session run; producer session must end before capture).

receipts enforce PRODUCED->SEALED->PUBLISHED->CAPTURED->CONSUMED order, exact sequence, and predecessor-hash structural linkage. NOTE: a forged predecessor whose signature validates under the caller-known development _DEV_KEY is ADR-0126-deferred and is NOT closed by this packet; only structural sequence/hash linkage and in-process chain integrity are swept.

Caller purpose, source descriptor purpose, published descriptor purpose, retained stream purpose and derived/captured port purpose must agree. Keep the RR-001 descriptor-vs-published check immediately after lookup, but anchor the publication lookup to retained receipt/stream identity first, so a mutated published dict cannot bless itself. Reject frozen-purpose mutation before deriving/capturing.

one CAPTURED stream yields exactly one CONSUMED; a second consume of the same stream refuses (in-process). The authorization-entry dedupe in authorize_capture_set (commit dedupe, trust.py ~4891) is retained.

Under the existing lifecycle lock, authenticate retained immutable publication -> frozen port -> verified capture -> member path/handle -> bindings input -> lifecycle port -> artifact payload/audit records within existing broker/view/intern ownership. Every listed accessor validates its exact parent/broker/stream/input association and returns only retained values or refuses. Mutable handle slots never determine returned payload/audit or re-enable spent member/input state. The _LIFECYCLE_VIEWS registry alone is not sufficient authority; validate against broker-held authenticated records. No parallel writer, ledger, planner, or tape engine.

Retain the original output-member path alongside the sealed handle in the EXISTING authenticated publish-sealed intern record at publication. Validate prepared and stream-pin output_member agree before seal/publication; on capture/open/bind validate both agree with that immutable retained path and that it exists in the retained sealed manifest. Use the returned retained path to select/parse the artifact, never re-read mutable subject.output_member as authority. A single poke of stream pin, sealed/prepared side, or publish-sealed intern alone cannot select another member, including another valid member with a valid digest. Preserve v1 receipt bytes and existing sole writer.

Descriptor-to-token lookup compares all six caller fields against independently retained descriptors of live publications, requires exactly one match, then resolves and validates that exact authenticated token stream and PUBLISHED head. Remove both partial prefix scans and mutable-descriptor self-blessing. Distinct snapshot/node/output/purpose identities remain usable in either order even when root_ref/snapshot_version/document_sha256 are equal. Duplicate complete retained descriptors refuse ambiguity before effects.

Separate diagnostic lookup derives original stream from existing authenticated publish-sealed -> sealed -> prepared identity, ignores mutable descriptor and publish-stream selector, validates retained in-memory PRODUCED/SEALED/PUBLISHED facts, stream digest, original output path and sealed manifest. It never reloads/recovers/reads exposed receipt_store or issues authority. Existing post-tamper committed-view diagnostics and A-to-B stream-intern mint assertions remain valid: return original A or refuse inconsistent retained identity, never report B as A.

Use one broker-owned validation helper over retained publication/frozen/capture/verified/bindings graph at each v1 effect boundary. It checks complete publication snapshot, original output/member manifest, original frozen source/port, and exact session/stream/port association from authenticated records; mutable slots cannot replace those associations. Stage-specific head is PUBLISHED before CAPTURED commit and CAPTURED before provider/member delivery, bindings construction, or CONSUMED append. Pre-CAPTURED candidate session is not registered yet: validate publication/frozen/request facts without requiring registration; after CAPTURED require exact registered session and captured actor/port. Resolve existing graph records rather than caller handle fields. Return retained validated facts for the effect. Revalidate after staging/fault schedules immediately before sole-writer CAPTURED/CONSUMED publication. P4 retains its existing repeated final validation; no second writer. After successful CONSUMED, retained port/artifact access continues through immutable view checks only without exposed-store reload.

CapturedJsonArtifact.value/audit: replace _value or _audit, or mutate original source aliases; validate consumed input and return retained frozen payload/audit or refuse

Repeated valid artifact value/audit access stays compatible; member bytes remain one-shot; no provider reopen; post-CONSUMED refusal leaves the existing valid receipt intact with no additional effects
change stream pin output_member to another valid sealed member after publish, after capture, or after open_capture; refuse before further CAPTURED/CONSUMED/provider effects
change prepared output_member or replace the sealed/prepared association with a different member path; compare against the independent retained original path

change output-member path before seal/publication; refuse before storing a publication with a changed output identity

same snapshot-looking fields but different producer/document/node/output/purpose must never resolve an arbitrary earlier token; ambiguous or missing exact binding refuses
Separate node-only, output-only, purpose-only descriptor differences with equal root/snapshot/document; distinct WORM member paths; complete v1 lifecycle in both lookup orders.
P4 positive authorization with each exact publication in presence of same-prefix siblings; signed fixture graph binds the selected publication.
Two distinct runs yielding identical complete retained six-field descriptors: descriptor-to-token lookup must refuse ambiguity before freeze/session/member/receipt effects.

Mint publish-stream A to B: operational capture refuses; independent non-authorizing audits still report actual A and B streams. Existing exposed-store truncation diagnostics read retained committed view without recovery.

After bindings creation but before require or direct _consume_binding: independently mutate published descriptor six fields, original prepared/pin output path and identity, frozen source/node/input/purpose/digest, session stream/run, binding stream/port, and sealed manifest; refuse before CONSUMED/provider/session effects.
After capture before open, after verified before bindings, and after verified before pre-consumption member delivery: sweep the same retained identity family before effects.
At legacy staged/precommit fault schedule, mutate retained publication/frozen/port identity once; final validation refuses with no CAPTURED/session publication.
One authenticated intern substitution alone in capture/verified/bindings/publication records must not create a new consumption authority; do not combine with handle poke.
After successful CONSUMED, repeated valid retained artifact reads remain usable despite later exposed-store tamper; no new receipt, provider reopen, or consume.
Corrected retry following pre-effect mismatch uses restored valid identity with unchanged nonce and succeeds once; no spent-state update before refusal.
